description: This PHP script acts as a test client for a remote XML-RPC server testing environment. It constructs and sends multiple 'executeTestCase' requests with different test case names and displays the server responses.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A class used to make XML-RPC client requests to a server, defined in an external file.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Sends an XML-RPC method call with arguments to the server.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Retrieves the server's response to the last XML-RPC request.
